pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Adds the current-main v5 Native 2D service-backed Editor workspace foundation: stable SpriteRef scene creation, typed Sprite Atlas / Sprite Animation / Tile Set authoring, and gesture-backed sparse Tile Map editing. Persisted mutation stays in shared authoring services; this slice intentionally excludes Scene View projection/drop integration so it can be validated independently.
